kit.hook: Kindle or Kobo? The birthday is Saturday.

scenes.narration: Kindle or Kobo? The birthday is Saturday.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a laptop with two shopping tabs open

scenes.narration: One question decides it: where do their books come from? Stay for the gift that makes it work.
scenes.onScreen: Where do their books come from?
scenes.visual: b-roll:a stack of library books next to a phone

scenes.narration: Years of Kindle purchases, or Audible? The Paperwhite. Bigger 7 inch screen, and Amazon claims up to 12 weeks a charge.
Library borrower? The Kobo Clara BW has Libby built in, and no ads by default.
Reads lying down? The Kobo is lighter, 174 grams to the Kindle's 214.
scenes.visual: product:Kobo Clara BW held above a pillow

scenes.narration: Both are rated IPX8, good for 2 meters of water for an hour. Bath reading approved.
Add a book gift card. An e-reader with nothing on it is a very nice coaster.
scenes.visual: b-roll:an e-reader holding up a coffee cup

scenes.narration: One tab closes. Saturday, they are three chapters in by dinner. The full comparison is at the link.
